Celgene (CELG) Holding Upped by Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co; Gogo (GOGO) Holder Whitebox Advisors Has Decreased Its Position 
April 17, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney 
Sharlyn C. Heslam increased its stake in Celgene Corp (CELG) by 24.55% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co bought 29,140 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.30% with the market. The hedge fund run by Sharlyn C. Heslam held 147,819 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.43M, up from 118,679 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co who had been investing in Celgene Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $68.69B market cap company. The stock increased 0.86% or $0.78 during the last trading session, reaching $91.32. About 1.59M shares traded. Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) has declined 31.28% since April 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.83% the S&P500. 
Andy Redleaf decreased its stake in Gogo Inc (GOGO) by 56.91% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
